briefdescription.para: Include guard for the AXI VDMA internal header.

briefdescription.para: Provides function checks whether reset operation is done.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the DMA channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns non-zero if reset is ongoing, 0 if reset is done.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a DMA channel is running.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on.

simplesect.para: Returns non-zero if the channel is running, or 0 if idle.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether a DMA channel is busy.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns non-zero if the channel is busy, 0 if idle.

briefdescription.para: Gets the current status of a channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

briefdescription.para: Dumps registers from one DMA channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if channel is not running.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

is the interrupt mask for interrupts to be enabled

briefdescription.para: Disables interrupts for a channel.

detaileddescription.para: Interrupts that are not specified by the. interrupt mask are not affected.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the interrupt mask for interrupts to be disabled

briefdescription.para: Gets pending interrupts of a channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns the mask of pending interrupts.

briefdescription.para: Gets the enabled interrupts of a channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns the mask of enabled interrupts.

is the interrupt mask for interrupts to be cleared

briefdescription.para: Starts a transfer.

detaileddescription.para: This function setup the DMA engine and start the engine to do the transfer.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the pointer to the setup structure

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if not initialized, XST_DEVICE_BUSY if busy, or channel error code.

briefdescription.para: Sets BD addresses to a different memory region.

detaileddescription.para: In some systems, it is convenient to put BDs into a certain region of the memory. This function enables that.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the physical starting address for BDs
is the Virtual starting address for BDs. For systems that do not use MMU, then virtual address is the same as physical address

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_DEVICE_BUSY if channel is busy.
We assume that the memory region starting from BdAddrPhys is large enough to hold all the BDs.

briefdescription.para: Configures one DMA channel using the configuration structure.

detaileddescription.para: Setup the control register and BDs, however, BD addresses are not set.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the pointer to the setup structure

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if not initialized, XST_DEVICE_BUSY if busy, XST_INVALID_PARAM on invalid configuration.

briefdescription.para: Configures buffer addresses for one DMA channel.

detaileddescription.para: The buffer addresses are physical addresses. Access to 32 Frame Buffer Addresses in direct mode is done through XAxiVdma_ChannelHiFrmAddrEnable/Disable Functions. 0 - Access Bank0 Registers (0x5C - 0x98) 1 - Access Bank1 Registers (0x5C - 0x98)

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the set of addresses for the transfers
is the number of frames to set the address

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if not initialized, XST_INVALID_PARAM on invalid buffer address.

briefdescription.para: Starts one DMA channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if not initialized, XST_DEVICE_BUSY if busy, XST_DMA_ERROR on start failure.

briefdescription.para: Stops one DMA channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on

briefdescription.para: Sets the frame counter and delay counter for one channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the frame counter value to be set
is the delay counter value to be set

simplesect.para: Returns XST_SUCCESS on success, XST_FAILURE if not initialized, XST_INVALID_PARAM on invalid value, XST_NO_FEATURE if counter is disabled.

briefdescription.para: Gets the frame counter and delay counter for both channels.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on
is the pointer for the returning frame counter value
is the pointer for the returning delay counter value

simplesect.para: If FrmCnt return as 0, then the channel is not initialized

briefdescription.para: Returns the error bits for a DMA channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on.

simplesect.para: Returns channel error bits, or 0 if there are no errors.

briefdescription.para: Clears selected error bits for a DMA channel.

parameterdescription.para: is the pointer to the channel to work on.
is the mask of error bits to clear.
